fields.name: live game memory (not save data)
fields.meaning: The first 20000 bytes of the cartridge memory are the game's working memory while playing; the save is a copy of parts of it kept further up. Changes every frame; not read as a save at power-on
fields.evidence: diff blank->power-on (written at power-on), code e000:10F8/2AB8/F980 copy from it

fields.name: save marker
fields.meaning: 0x0100 when a save exists, 0 on blank memory. Checked at the title screen to decide whether CONTINUE can be chosen
fields.evidence: code e000:0FCA writes 0x100, e000:0FE8 compares; verified save = 0x0100, blank = 0

fields.name: field snapshot: header word
fields.meaning: First word of the field snapshot (0 in tested saves)
fields.evidence: value in two natural saves

fields.name: field snapshot: map data segment
fields.meaning: Same value as the event-script data segment kept in the event block (0xAD63 in tested saves); the data area of the current map
fields.evidence: value equal to event block word 0 in both saves

fields.name: field snapshot: current field handler
fields.meaning: Far code address of the routine that runs the current field screen (E000:2A84 in tested saves), resumed after loading
fields.evidence: code e000:1793-17A9 reads it and calls it; set by e000:1021/1049

fields.name: field snapshot: unknown 0008
fields.meaning: Unknown words
fields.evidence: same values in both saves

fields.name: field snapshot: field variables
fields.meaning: Small variables of the field screen (mode, counters, timers). Event scripts can address this area. Word at +0x0A (offset 0x001A) counts frames; word at +0x10 (0x0020) is the field mode (set to 4 after saving)
fields.evidence: code e000:2C97 (script space base 0x10), e000:5EA5 sets [0x20]=4 after save, e000:177D clears [0x1A]; differs between the two saves at 0x1A

fields.name: field snapshot: player figure
fields.meaning: First entry of the figure table: the player character on the map. Bytes +2..+9 hold the on-screen box (left, top, right, bottom as 16-bit numbers); they change when the player walks
fields.evidence: differs between saves taken at different spots (010D,00F0,011D,0100 -> 0130,00CE,0140,00DE); code e000:35AA clears 0x56-byte figure records

fields.name: field snapshot: other figures
fields.meaning: Entries 2-30 of the figure table (people, effects and objects on the current map), 0x56 bytes each
fields.evidence: code e000:2C7C (script space 0xBE), e000:35AA (0x56-byte record); several entries differ between saves

fields.name: field snapshot: unknown 0AD2
fields.meaning: Unknown word between the figure table and the next table
fields.evidence: value 0 in tested saves

fields.name: field snapshot: table at 0AD4
fields.meaning: Field table addressed by event scripts (contents not decoded)
fields.evidence: code e000:2C81 (script space base 0xAD4)

fields.name: field snapshot: table at 104E
fields.meaning: Field table addressed by event scripts (contents not decoded)
fields.evidence: code e000:2C8C (script space base 0x104E)

fields.name: field snapshot: table at 1578
fields.meaning: Field table addressed by event scripts (contents not decoded)
fields.evidence: code e000:2C91 (script space base 0x1578)

fields.name: field snapshot: table at 1958
fields.meaning: Field table addressed by event scripts (contents not decoded)
fields.evidence: code e000:2C86 (script space base 0x1958)

fields.name: field snapshot: scroll and screen state
fields.meaning: Map scroll position and screen layer state; changes when the player walks to another part of the town
fields.evidence: 0x1CDE-0x1D30 differ after walking; code e000:1768-1780 clears 0x1CCC-0x1DD6

fields.name: field snapshot: overlap with event block
fields.meaning: The last 36 bytes of the field snapshot are the first 36 bytes of the event block (same memory, saved twice). On loading the event block is copied after the field snapshot, so the event block copy wins
fields.evidence: code e000:10F8 (0x1E14 bytes from 0) and e000:2AB8 (0x4B0 bytes from 0x1DF0) overlap; e000:0FA7 load order

fields.name: field snapshot checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the 7700 snapshot bytes (4E22-6C35) plus 0xFF
fields.evidence: code e000:1117 (save) / e000:113C (check); recomputed on all 32 valid saves

fields.name: event: script data segment
fields.meaning: Segment of the event-script data of the current map (0xAD63 in tested saves)
fields.evidence: code e000:2B50

fields.name: event: script entry number
fields.meaning: Word taken from the script header when a script starts (0x00C3 in tested saves)
fields.evidence: code e000:2B69

fields.name: event: script position
fields.meaning: Offset of the running event script inside its data (0x07EE in tested saves)
fields.evidence: code e000:2B6F

fields.name: event: script scratch value
fields.meaning: Temporary value used by event-script commands (1 in tested saves)
fields.evidence: code e000:2C66

fields.name: event flags and variables
fields.meaning: 512 story variables (16-bit each) used by event scripts: what has happened in the story. All zero this early in the game
fields.evidence: code e000:2C75 (index*2 + 0x1DF8), cleared by e000:2B27 when a new story starts; zero in tested saves

fields.name: event: local variables
fields.meaning: 10 short-lived event-script variables (16-bit), cleared when a script starts
fields.evidence: code e000:2C6E (index*2 + 0x21F8), cleared at e000:2B74

fields.name: event: unknown 220C
fields.meaning: Unknown
fields.evidence: zero in tested saves

fields.name: event: script work area
fields.meaning: Area cleared when an event script starts; purpose not decoded
fields.evidence: code e000:2B90 clears 0x7C bytes; zero in tested saves

fields.name: event: unknown 2290
fields.meaning: Unknown tail of the event block
fields.evidence: zero in tested saves

fields.name: event block checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the 1200 event bytes (6C38-70E7) plus 0xFF
fields.evidence: code e000:2AD7 / e000:2AFC; recomputed on all 32 valid saves

fields.name: restart counter
fields.meaning: Counts restarts of the story through the game's own restart routine (0 in tested saves)
fields.evidence: code e000:105C increments (routine e000:1037, called from f000:CD77), e000:ED07 reads

fields.name: party size
fields.meaning: Number of characters in the party (1 in tested saves, at most 5)
fields.evidence: code e000:1DFC/FC0E loop over it, e000:FB26 caps at 5, e000:FB9E and e000:FBF0 decrement

fields.name: party member 1: character number
fields.meaning: Which character this is (1 = the hero). The creation routine picks starting values and gear from it
fields.evidence: code d000:0902 table lookup by it, e000:FA8D compares 1..4

fields.name: party member 1: name
fields.meaning: Character name typed on the name screen, up to 32 bytes, zero-padded. Kana take two bytes (first byte 0xAA), letters and the space one byte (ASCII). Test name: two kana, d, space, five kana
fields.evidence: code e000:FAB5 copies 0x20 bytes from the name-entry buffer; stored bytes AA A2 AA A2 64 20 AA BF x5 match the name screen (AA A2 = hiragana A, AA BF = hiragana TE); other kana codes unknown

fields.name: party member 1: hero flag
fields.meaning: 2 = main character: kept in the party even at 0 HP, while others are dropped (e000:1E2C). From the character table
fields.evidence: code e000:1E32 compares [record+0x22] with 2 before dropping; hero = 2

fields.name: party member 1: unknown 24
fields.meaning: Unknown (0 for the hero). From the character table; no reader found
fields.evidence: value in tested saves; written by d000:09B9

fields.name: party member 1: level
fields.meaning: Character level, 1 to 99
fields.evidence: code d000:0BFA increments, d000:0BC0 caps at 99, d000:0902 sets 1

fields.name: party member 1: experience
fields.meaning: Experience points towards the next level (0 for the hero at the start)
fields.evidence: code d000:0BCB compares with the next-level value, d000:0D0C resets to 0 on level-up

fields.name: party member 1: experience for next level
fields.meaning: Experience needed to reach the next level (100 at level 1), from a table in the program
fields.evidence: code d000:0D1D loads CS:[0xDB6 + (level-1)*4]; d000:0BC0 compares against it

fields.name: party member 1: unknown 30
fields.meaning: Unknown (4 for the hero). From the character table; no reader found
fields.evidence: value in tested saves; written by d000:09C0

fields.name: party member 1: unknown 32
fields.meaning: Unknown (0 for the hero). From the character table; no reader found
fields.evidence: value in tested saves; written by d000:09C7

fields.name: party member 1: base battle stats
fields.meaning: Four base stats (30, 25, 10, 10 for the hero). Raised with bonus stat points and by gear; gear requirements are checked against them; they feed the derived battle stats
fields.evidence: code d000:0A59 (bonus points), d000:0FB6/10D8 (gear add/remove), d000:0D38 (requirement check), d000:11CE (derive)

fields.name: party member 1: HP
fields.meaning: Current hit points (90 at the start)
fields.evidence: code e000:FC14 and f000:B26D copy max into it (full heal); e000:1DF2 sets 0 when the character falls

fields.name: party member 1: max HP
fields.meaning: Maximum hit points (90 at the start)
fields.evidence: code e000:FC14; d000:0C28 grows it on level-up

fields.name: party member 1: MP
fields.meaning: Current magic points (35 at the start); spell costs are taken from it
fields.evidence: code e000:FC1A (full restore), f000:5A48 subtracts, e000:FC5F compares with a spell cost

fields.name: party member 1: max MP
fields.meaning: Maximum magic points (35 at the start)
fields.evidence: code e000:FC1A; d000:0C3B grows it on level-up

fields.name: party member 1: derived battle stats
fields.meaning: Five battle stats recomputed from the base stats, the level, gear and magic (each at most 999); read by the battle damage code. Zero before the first battle
fields.evidence: code d000:11DC-123A recomputes (base/5 + level terms), d000:0FB6 adds gear, d000:13CF adds magic; read at f000:42AE/5F97

fields.name: party member 1: derived affinity values
fields.meaning: Four derived values (5, 5, 55, 5 for the hero), recomputed from the level, gear and magic and kept between -99 and +80
fields.evidence: code d000:124C clamps, d000:0FB6 adds gear, d000:13CF adds magic; read in battle at e000:230F

fields.name: party member 1: weapon attribute
fields.meaning: Low byte = kind of the equipped weapon (must match the spell school for magic bonuses); bit 8 = the weapon's stat requirement is not met. Set when gear is put on, cleared when taken off
fields.evidence: code d000:0FDB/0FEE set, d000:10F9 clears, d000:13E1 compares low byte, d000:0EAD tests bit 8

fields.name: party member 1: proficiency bitmask
fields.meaning: Bit (n-1) allows weapon class n (hero 0x0D23: classes 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 12). From the character table
fields.evidence: code d000:0D5C tests bit (class-1) when checking gear

fields.name: party member 1: equipment
fields.meaning: Eight equipped item numbers (0 = empty slot), 16-bit each. Slots 1-6 also grant the item's stat bonuses
fields.evidence: code d000:0F30 stores by slot, d000:0D38 picks the slot and checks it is empty; empty in tested saves

fields.name: party member 1: derived magic values
fields.meaning: Ten magic values recomputed from gear and magic (each at most 999). Zero before the first battle
fields.evidence: code d000:1060 adds gear bonuses, d000:149F adds a spell bonus, d000:12BB clamps; read in battle at f000:5FE3

fields.name: party member 1: magic list
fields.meaning: Up to 16 magic numbers the character knows (ten at the start: 1,3,5,7,23,20,32,9,41,52)
fields.evidence: code e000:FC46 and f000:5A5E read them next to the MP cost check; d000:13CF/12E5 branch on the id

fields.name: party member 1: magic mastery
fields.meaning: One mastery word per magic slot (0 = cannot use yet, 1..20). Multiplies magic bonuses and MP discounts
fields.evidence: code e000:FC4E requires nonzero, d000:0A83 caps at 20, d000:12E5/13CF multiply by it

fields.name: party member 1: bonus magic points
fields.meaning: Unspent magic points (3 for the hero); spent to raise magic mastery
fields.evidence: code d000:0AAE spends, d000:0CD9 grants on level-up, e000:FAA7 sets 3

fields.name: party member 1: bonus stat points
fields.meaning: Unspent stat points (10 for the hero); each raises one base stat by 1
fields.evidence: code d000:0A59 spends (random stat +1), d000:0C4D grants 3 on level-up, e000:FAA1 sets 10

fields.name: party member 1: graphics name
fields.meaning: Name of the character's graphics set as plain text (the hero: hr_fighter01)
fields.evidence: copied from the character table by d000:0989; value in tested saves

fields.name: party members 2-5
fields.meaning: Four more party records, 0xE2 bytes each, same layout as member 1 (empty in tested saves)
fields.evidence: code e000:1DE8 / FB2D (record = 0x3E84 + 0xE2 * index); zero in tested saves

fields.name: stored character count
fields.meaning: Number of characters held in the second character list (at most 10); also exchanged over the link cable
fields.evidence: code e000:FAE8 caps at 10, e000:FB0E increments, e000:F7D4 sends it on the serial port

fields.name: stored characters
fields.meaning: Second character list: 10 records of 0xE2 bytes in the party-record layout (empty in tested saves)
fields.evidence: code e000:FAEF-FB06 (record = 0x42F0 + 0xE2 * count), cleared by new-game setup e000:FA0E

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money. A new game starts with 300; gains are capped at 65535 and spending stops at 0
fields.evidence: code e000:FACF sets 300, e000:6C5C adds (cap 0xFFFF), e000:6C89 subtracts (floor 0); tested save = 300

fields.name: item count
fields.meaning: Number of entries in the item list (0 in tested saves, at most 60)
fields.evidence: code e000:FC95 caps at 60, e000:FCA9 increments

fields.name: item list
fields.meaning: Up to 60 item numbers (16-bit each)
fields.evidence: code e000:FCA5 appends, e000:1164 reads

fields.name: unknown 4C40
fields.meaning: Unknown tail of the party block (zero in tested saves)
fields.evidence: zero in tested saves

fields.name: party block checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the 3600 party bytes (70EA-7EF9) plus 0xFF
fields.evidence: code e000:F99F / e000:F9C4; recomputed on all 32 valid saves

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not used by the save (zero)
fields.evidence: never read at load in the boot trace; zero in all states
